name: Chroma
description: Open-source embedding database used as an agent memory store.
descriptionZh: 开源嵌入数据库，常用作 Agent 记忆存储。
keyFact: Chroma is an Apache-2.0, AI-native embedding database created in 2022 with Python, JavaScript and Rust SDKs, deployable embedded, single-node or distributed; a managed Chroma Cloud is also offered.
keyFactZh: Chroma 是 2022 年创建的 Apache-2.0、AI 原生嵌入数据库，提供 Python、JavaScript 与 Rust SDK，支持嵌入式、单机与分布式部署，另提供托管的 Chroma Cloud。
